source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 13 (PDF 1-11), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 13 (Thermoregulation and Osmoregulation) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define homeostasis. Name its important processes.
(Homeostasis ki definition likhein. Is ke ahem processes ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Homeostasis woh zaroori amal hai jis se jandar bairooni tabdeeli ke bawajood mustaqil andaruni mahaul rakhte hain. Is ke ahem processes thermoregulation, osmoregulation aur excretion hain.

book_ref.quote: Homeostasis consists of a wide range of mechanisms

blocks.prompt:
2 What are receptors? Give two examples from the human body.
(Receptors kya hain? Insaani jism se do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Receptors (sensors) khaas structures (organs, tissues, cells ya subcellular hisse) hain jo andaruni ya bairooni tabdeeli pehchan kar control centre ko khabar dete hain. Misaal: jild ke receptor cells temperature, khoon ki naliyon ke receptor cells blood pressure pehchante hain.

book_ref.quote: They also transmit the information of changes to the control centre

blocks.prompt:
3 What is the role of the control centre in homeostasis? Name the organs that act as control centres.
(Homeostasis mein control centre ka kya kirdar hai? Control centres ka kaam karne wale organs ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Control centres receptors se maloomat le kar us par amal karte hain aur effectors ko munasib paigham bhejte hain, taake andaruni mahaul set points ki tang hadd mein rahe. Dimagh, spinal cord aur endocrine glands control centres hain.

book_ref.quote: The control centres receive information from the receptors

blocks.prompt:
4 Differentiate between receptors and effectors.
(Receptors aur effectors mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Receptors tabdeeli pehchante hain; effectors use theek karne ka jawab dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Effectors are the parts of the body which respond when they receive message

rows: Andaruni ya bairooni tabdeeli pehchante hain
Control centre ka paigham milne par jawab dete hain
Control centre ko maloomat bhejte hain
Andaruni mahaul ko set points par wapas laate hain
Misaal: jild aur khoon ki naliyon ke receptor cells
Misaal: muscles (sukarte) aur glands (ratoobat)

blocks.prompt:
5 How do effectors respond when body temperature drops below the set point?
(Jab jism ka temperature set point se gir jaye to effectors kya jawab dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jild aur muscles ke effectors shivering aur vasoconstriction karte hain. Is se heat zyada banti hai aur temperature wapas set point tak aata hai.

book_ref.quote: This response increases heat production and raises the body temperature to the set point

blocks.prompt:
6 What are feedback mechanisms? Name their types.
(Feedback mechanisms kya hain? In ki qismon ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Feedback mechanisms, jo homeostasis ki bunyad hain, woh regulatory processes hain jin mein system ki paidawar khud system ke rawaiye ko control karti hai. Qismein: negative feedback aur positive feedback.

book_ref.quote: Feedback mechanisms are the foundations of homeostasis

blocks.prompt:
7 Differentiate between negative feedback and positive feedback.
(Negative feedback aur positive feedback mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono system ki paidawar se use control karte hain, magar ulti simt mein.

book_ref.quote: In homeostasis, positive feedback is less common than negative feedback

rows: Paidawar system ki sargarmi kam karti hai
Paidawar system ki sargarmi barhati hai
Regulation ki sab se aam shakal
Homeostasis mein kam aam
Tabdeeli ko set point par wapas laata hai
Asal stimulus ko barhata hai
Misalein: jism ka temperature, blood glucose, hormones
Misalein: khoon jamna, dard-e-zeh aur paidaish

blocks.prompt:
8 Outline the steps by which negative feedback lowers a body temperature above 37°C.
(Negative feedback 37°C se zyada temperature ko kin qadmon se kam karta hai? Mukhtasar likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Hypothalamus ke thermoreceptors izafa pehchante hain → hypothalamus ke thermoregulator (control centre) ko signal → woh effectors (sweat glands) ko signal deta hai → paseena temperature kam karta hai → kam temperature thermoreceptors par manfi asar dalta hai aur woh paigham band kar dete hain.

book_ref.quote: The control centre sends messages to effectors (e.g., sweat glands)

blocks.prompt:
9 Why does the positive feedback loop in childbirth stop?
(Paidaish ka positive feedback loop kab aur kyun rukta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Uterus ke sukarne se hypothalamus ko impulses jate hain, pituitary oxytocin kharij karta hai jo mazeed sukarne aur impulses paida karta hai. Yeh loop bachcha paida hone tak chalta hai, jis se stimulus khatam ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: This positive feedback loop continues until the baby is born

blocks.prompt:
10 How can unregulated positive feedback harm the body? Give the chapter's example.
(Be-qaboo positive feedback jism ko kaise nuqsan de sakta hai? Chapter ki misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Shadeed sozish ya infection mein immune cells cytokines kharij karte hain jo immune response ko mazeed ubharte hain. Agar yeh positive feedback theek control na ho to zyada sozish aur tissue ka nuqsan hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Sometimes, the un-regulated positive feedback systems can result in health problems

blocks.prompt:
11 Define osmoregulation. Why is it essential?
(Osmoregulation ki definition likhein. Yeh kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Osmoregulation jism ki raton mein paani aur solutes ka tawazun rakhna hai taake woh bohat patli ya gaarhi na hon. Yeh sahi blood pressure, organs ke theek kaam aur metabolism ke nizam ke liye zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: It ensures that the body fluids do not become too dilute or too concentrated

blocks.prompt:
12 Define osmosis. In which direction does water move?
(Osmosis ki definition likhein. Paani kis taraf jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Osmosis membrane ke aar paar paani ki diffusion hai. Yeh hamesha zyada patle (hypotonic) se kam patle (hypertonic) mehlool ki taraf hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Osmosis is the diffusion of water across a membrane

blocks.prompt:
13 Why do the body fluids of osmoconformers change with the surrounding medium?
(Osmoconformers ki jism ki ratoobat ird gird ke medium ke saath kyun badalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Osmoconformers apne jism mein paani aur solutes ki miqdar qaim nahi rakh sakte, is liye yeh medium ke saath badalti hai aur woh us ke isotonic rehte hain. Woh aam tor par mustaqil solutes wale mahaul, jaise samundar, mein rehte hain.

book_ref.quote: They cannot maintain the concentration of water and solutes in their bodies

blocks.prompt:
14 Give examples of osmoconformers among invertebrates and vertebrates.
(Invertebrates aur vertebrates mein osmoconformers ki misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Invertebrates: tamam samundari invertebrates aur kuch meethe paani ke invertebrates. Vertebrates: kuch samundari vertebrates jaise hag fishes, sharks aur rays.

book_ref.quote: some freshwater invertebrates and some marine vertebrates

blocks.prompt:
15 Name three mechanisms used by osmoregulators. Which animals are mostly osmoregulators?
(Osmoregulators ke teen tareeqon ke naam likhein. Zyada tar kaun se janwar osmoregulators hain?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Namak ki active transport
2. Namak jama karna
3. Paani bachana
Paani aur khushki ke aksar vertebrates osmoregulators hain.

book_ref.quote: They use various mechanisms for osmoregulation

blocks.prompt:
16 Why does water continuously enter the bodies of freshwater animals?
(Meethe paani ke janwaron ke jism mein paani musalsal kyun dakhil hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Meethe paani ke janwar apne mahaul ke hypertonic hain: un ki jism ki raton mein ird gird ke paani se zyada solutes hain. Is liye osmosis se paani andar aata hai, khaas tor par gills jaisi nufooz pazeer satahon se.

book_ref.quote: Water continuously enters their bodies through osmosis, particularly across permeable surfaces like gills

blocks.prompt:
17 How do freshwater animals solve their two osmotic problems?
(Meethe paani ke janwar apne do osmotic masail kaise hal karte hain?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Zaid paani: woh bari miqdar mein patla peshab banate hain aur bohat kam paani peete hain.
2. Namak ka nuqsan: woh active transport se namak wapas jism mein late hain.

book_ref.quote: To compensate the loss of salts, they actively transport salts back into their bodies

blocks.prompt:
18 Compare the osmotic problems and solutions of freshwater animals and hypotonic marine animals.
(Meethe paani ke janwaron aur hypotonic samundari janwaron ke osmotic masail aur hal ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: In ke masail ulte hain, is liye in ke hal bhi ulte hain.

book_ref.quote: Water constantly leaves their bodies via osmosis through the gills and skin

rows: Mahaul ke hypertonic
Mahaul ke hypotonic
Osmosis se paani andar aata hai
Osmosis se paani gills aur jild se bahar jata hai
Namak bahar nikalta hai
Namak andar aata hai (aur piye gaye samundari paani se)
Bohat kam paani peete hain
Musalsal samundari paani peete hain
Bari miqdar mein patla peshab
Bohat kam aur bohat gaarha peshab
Active tor par namak andar late hain
Chloride cells, kidneys aur rectal glands namak nikalte hain

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai 'most marine animals are hypotonic', magar usi chapter ke mutabiq tamam samundari invertebrates osmoconformers (isotonic) hain. Is liye yeh masla sirf un samundari janwaron ka hai jo samundar ke paani se hypotonic hain, jaise samundari machhliyan.

blocks.prompt:
19 Name the routes of water loss and of water gain in terrestrial animals.
(Khushki ke janwaron mein paani ke nuqsan aur hasool ke raaste likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Nuqsan: saans ki satahon se bukharat, jild se, aur waste ke ikhraj ke saath. Hasool: peena, khana aur metabolic water. Hasool aur metabolic water nuqsan ke barabar hone chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Terrestrial animals lose water to the environment through evaporation from respiratory surfaces

blocks.prompt:
20 Describe the impermeable outer layers of insects, reptiles, and mammals and birds.
(Insects, reptiles, aur mammals aur parindon ki na-nufooz pazeer bahar ki tahon ko bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Insects: chitin ka waxy exoskeleton. Reptiles: keratin ke waterproof scales. Mammals aur parinde: murda keratinized skin cells aur jild mein tel kharij karne wale glands. Yeh bukharat se paani ka nuqsan rokte hain.

book_ref.quote: They have relatively impermeable outer layers to prevent evaporative water loss

blocks.prompt:
21 How do desert animals and the Kangaroo Rat manage water?
(Sehrai janwar aur Kangaroo Rat paani ka intezam kaise karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bohat se sehrai janwar din ki garmi mein zameen ke andar rehte hain aur raat ko thandi nam hawa mein nikalte hain. Woh carbohydrate se bhare beej khate hain. Kangaroo Rat sirf cellular respiration ke metabolic water par zinda rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: These animals feed upon seeds of desert plants

blocks.prompt:
22 What is anhydrobiosis? Give an example.
(Anhydrobiosis kya hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Anhydrobiosis woh ghunoodgi hai jis mein kuch invertebrates jism ka taqreeban saara paani kho kar chale jate hain aur saalon baad paani wapas aane par phir zinda ho jate hain. Misaal: tardigrades (water bears).

book_ref.quote: They come to active life years later when water returns

blocks.text: 13.2.3 Nature of Excretory Products in relation to Habitat

blocks.prompt:
23 Why is osmoregulation coupled with excretion of nitrogenous wastes in many animals?
(Bohat se janwaron mein osmoregulation nitrogenous wastes ke ikhraj se kyun jura hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nitrogenous wastes (ammonia, urea, uric acid) bare metabolic wastes hain aur paani mein ghul kar kharij hote hain, is liye in ke ikhraj mein paani lagta hai. Mukhtalif mahaul ke janwar dastiyab paani ke mutabiq mukhtalif shaklein kharij karte hain.

book_ref.quote: These wastes are excreted as water solutes

blocks.prompt:
24 Why can only freshwater animals excrete ammonia? Name two examples.
(Sirf meethe paani ke janwar hi ammonia kyun kharij kar sakte hain? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Ammonia bohat zehreeli hai aur aik gram ko be-zarar karne ke liye 500 mL paani chahiye. Itna paani sirf meethe paani ke janwar afford kar sakte hain, jaise aksar machhliyan aur protozoans (sponges, coelenterates bhi).

book_ref.quote: Such plenty of water can only be afforded by freshwater animals

blocks.prompt:
25 Why do terrestrial ureotelic animals convert ammonia to urea?
(Khushki ke ureotelic janwar ammonia ko urea mein kyun badalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Khushki ke janwaron ko paani bachana hai, woh bohat paani ke saath ammonia kharij nahi kar sakte. Woh liver mein use urea banate hain jo kam zehreela hai aur fi gram sirf 50 mL paani leta hai, aur kidneys se kharij karte hain.

book_ref.quote: As the terrestrial animals face the challenge of conserving water

blocks.prompt:
26 What is gout? How is it related to uric acid?
(Gout kya hai? Is ka uric acid se kya talluq hai?)
blocks.explanation: Insaan thora uric acid kharij karte hain jo purines ke tootne se liver mein banta hai. Khoon mein uric acid zyada ho to joron aur tissues mein crystals bante hain aur dardnak bimari gout (naqras) hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Uric acid is produced in the liver

blocks.prompt:
27 Differentiate between ammonia and uric acid as nitrogenous wastes.
(Nitrogenous wastes ke tor par ammonia aur uric acid mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh sab se zyada aur sab se kam paani lene wale nitrogenous wastes hain.

book_ref.quote: It is less soluble in water and makes precipitates

rows: Bohat zehreeli
Urea se bhi kam zehreela
Aik gram ko 500 mL paani
Aik gram ko sirf 1 mL paani
Bohat paani ke saath jaldi kharij
Kam hal pazeer; tah-nasheen banata hai
Meethe paani ke janwar: aksar machhliyan, protozoans, sponges, coelenterates
Insects, sehrai janwar, parinde, aksar reptiles

blocks.prompt:
28 Why do birds and insects excrete uric acid even though its formation uses a lot of energy?
(Parinde aur insects uric acid kyun kharij karte hain halankeh is ke banne mein bohat energy lagti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Inhein khushk mahaul mein paani bachane ka shadeed masla hai aur woh urea bhi kharij nahi kar sakte. Uric acid sab se kam zehreela, kam hal pazeer hai, tah-nasheen banata hai aur fi gram sirf 1 mL paani leta hai, is liye paani bachta hai.

book_ref.quote: face an extreme water conservation challenge due to the arid nature of their environment

blocks.prompt:
29 How much water is needed to excrete 2 g of nitrogenous waste as ammonia, as urea and as uric acid?
(2 g nitrogenous waste ko ammonia, urea aur uric acid ki shakal mein kharij karne ke liye kitna paani chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Ammonia: 2 × 500 mL = 1000 mL. Urea: 2 × 50 mL = 100 mL. Uric acid: 2 × 1 mL = 2 mL. Is liye uric acid sab se zyada paani bachata hai.

book_ref.quote: One gram of ammonia requires 500 mL of water to dissolve it to nontoxic level

blocks.prompt:
30 How does a fall in temperature below the optimum affect enzymes and cell membranes?
(Behtareen temperature se kam hone par enzymes aur cell membranes par kya asar hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Behtareen hadd se kam par enzyme-substrate ki takkar kam aur metabolic rate kam ho jata hai. Kam temperature cell membranes ko sakht aur bhurbhura bhi bana deta hai.

book_ref.quote: If temperature falls below the optimal, enzyme-substrate collisions decrease

blocks.text: 13.3.1 Types of Animals on the basis of Heat Source

blocks.prompt:
31 Give the behavioural responses of an ectotherm when it is too cold and too hot.
(Ectotherm ke rawaiyati responses likhein jab use bohat sardi aur bohat garmi lage.)
blocks.explanation: Ectotherms rawaiye se temperature control karte hain, heat ki taraf ya us se door ja kar.

book_ref.quote: Ectotherms use behavioral thermoregulation

rows: Dhoop senkta hai (radiation)
Saaya dhoondta hai
Garam chattan par baithta hai (conduction)
Thandi zameen mein bil banata hai
Bohat thande ilaqe mein sab se thande mahinon mein dormant
Mahaul ki garmi se bachta hai

blocks.prompt:
32 Why do ectotherms rely on heat from the environment? Name the vertebrate ectotherms.
(Ectotherms mahaul ki heat par kyun inhisar karte hain? Vertebrate ectotherms ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: In ka metabolic rate bohat kam hai, is liye woh temperature barhane aur qaim rakhne ke liye kaafi heat nahi bana sakte. Vertebrate ectotherms: machhliyan, amphibians aur reptiles.

book_ref.quote: Among the vertebrates, fishes, amphibians, and reptiles are ectotherms

blocks.prompt:
33 How do endotherms produce and retain body heat?
(Endotherms jism ki heat kaise banate aur rokte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Woh zyada heat andaruni metabolism se banate hain. Sardi mein kanpte hain (muscles ka sukarna) ya brown adipose tissue jalate hain. Baal, par ya charbi ki insulation heat rokti hai.

book_ref.quote: Endotherms generate the majority of their body heat through internal metabolism

blocks.text: 13.3.2 Types of Animals on the basis ability of Thermoregulation

blocks.prompt:
34 What advantage do poikilotherms have over homeotherms?
(Poikilotherms ko homeotherms par kya faida hai?)
blocks.explanation: Poikilotherms ko mustaqil temperature ke 'indhan' ke liye bohat khana nahi chahiye. Is liye woh kam ghizaiyat wale mahaul mein zinda reh sakte hain jahan homeotherm bhooka mar jaye.

book_ref.quote: Poikilotherms do not need to consume massive amounts of food

blocks.prompt:
35 How do homeotherms keep their body temperature constant? Give an example.
(Homeotherms apna temperature mustaqil kaise rakhte hain? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Woh dimagh ke hypothalamus ko 'thermostat' bana kar mahaul se qata nazar thanda ya garam karne ke responses shuru karte hain. Misaal: insaan bohat thande aur bohat garam mahaul mein bhi taqreeban 37°C rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: humans maintain their internal temperature at roughly 37°C

blocks.prompt:
36 Why are humans called endothermic homeotherms? Which feedback controls their temperature?
(Insaanon ko endothermic homeotherms kyun kehte hain? Kaun sa feedback un ka temperature control karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Insaan andaruni metabolism se heat banate hain (endothermic) aur taqreeban 37°C mustaqil temperature rakhte hain (homeotherms). Negative feedback se control hota hai: jild ke thermoreceptors hypothalamus ko aur hypothalamus muscles aur glands ko signal dete hain.

book_ref.quote: They regulate body temperature through negative feedback mechanism

blocks.prompt:
37 Name four responses of the human body to hypothermia.
(Hypothermia par insaani jism ke chaar responses ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Vasoconstriction (khoon se kam heat zaya)
2. Shivering (heat banna)
3. Rongte khare: baal khare, phansi hawa insulator
4. Metabolic rate mein izafa (heat banna)

book_ref.quote: Increased metabolic rate also produces heat to raise the body temperature

blocks.prompt:
38 Name three responses of the human body to hyperthermia.
(Hyperthermia par insaani jism ke teen responses ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Vasodilation: jild ki capillaries mein zyada khoon aur zyada heat ka ikhraj.
2. Paseena: paseene ka urna jism thanda karta hai.
3. Kam thyroxine: kam basal metabolic rate, kam andaruni heat.

book_ref.quote: So, the internal heat production is reduced

blocks.prompt:
39 How do thermoreceptors help us take voluntary actions against heat or cold?
(Thermoreceptors garmi ya sardi ke khilaf ikhtiyari iqdamat mein kaise madad karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Thermoreceptors dimagh ke aala marakiz ko bhi ubharte hain, is liye hum garmi ya sardi 'mehsoos' karte hain. Is se hum naha lena ya pankhe aur heater chalana jaise iqdamat karte hain.

book_ref.quote: It allows us to take more actions like taking a bath
